passed_checks.check_name: Ensure KMS key policy does not contain wildcard (*) principal
code_block:
RdsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for encrypting Aurora PostgreSQL cluster, Performance Insights, and CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds-kms
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

passed_checks.check_name: Ensure all data stored in Aurora is securely encrypted at rest
code_block:
DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref ClusterIdentifier
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: !Ref DBEngineVersion
      EngineMode: provisioned
      DatabaseName: !Ref DatabaseName
      Port: !Ref DBPort
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref ClusterParameterGroup
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      DeletionProtection: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionDays
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - postgresql
        - upgrade
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      MasterUserSecretKmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref ServerlessMinACU
        MaxCapacity: !Ref ServerlessMaxACU
      EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: !If [EnableIAMDatabaseAuth, true, false]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-aurora-pg
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
